summary: Completed testing of iteration 8 features. All 7 requested features verified working: Header 'Empresas' link, Competência auto-format, Dashboard 'Selecionar Empresa' button, Validation success message, Justificativa da IA, 'Memória da IA' button, and /api/analise-aliquotas-saida endpoint. 10/10 backend tests passed, all frontend features verified.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent issue where modal shows 'Nenhuma empresa cadastrada' on first login even though companies exist. This is a timing issue with AppContext not re-fetching companies after login. Workaround: refresh page or navigate to Companies page first.

passed_tests: FEATURE 1: Header 'Empresas' link - Link visible in header at y=14 with data-testid='nav-companies'
FEATURE 2: CompanySelector competência auto-format - 122025 → 12/2025 works correctly
FEATURE 2: CompanySelector helper text - 'Digite apenas números (ex: 122025 → 12/2025)' visible
FEATURE 3: Dashboard 'Selecionar Empresa' button - Visible when no company selected
FEATURE 4: Validation success message - Green toast 'Produto validado com sucesso!' appears on approval
FEATURE 5: Justificativa da IA - Field exists in products (justificativa_ia)
FEATURE 6: 'Memória da IA' button - Button visible with title 'A IA memoriza suas correções para aplicar automaticamente no futuro'
FEATURE 7: /api/analise-aliquotas-saida endpoint - Returns 200 with correct structure
Backend: /api/analise-aliquotas-saida returns empresa, competencia, total_documentos_saida, total_produtos, produtos_com_alerta, resumo_alertas
Backend: resumo_alertas contains total, icms, pis, cofins counts
Backend: produto structure contains documento, codigo, descricao, valor_total, aliquotas, valores, alertas
Backend: Documents have justificativa_ia field in produtos
